scenario: A staged release trips its declared failure criteria at 10% exposure; the abort path rolls the exposure back to zero.

release.subject: app at digest sha-a
release.abort criteria: error rate above threshold, declared before exposure

events: error rate exceeds the declared threshold
rollback executes and verifies at 0% exposure

reasons: the result records a failed-and-rolled-back release as the honest outcome
the timeline includes the exposure state at failure and the verified rollback
a retry is a new execution under a still-valid authorization, not an edit of this result
must_not: smooth the failure into a released-after-retries narrative
leave the exposure state ambiguous after the abort
delete or rewrite the failed release record when a later attempt succeeds
